page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.vgn6i-m4-vws.xlarge is a KVM-based virtual server belonging to the ecs.vgn6i-vws family. It features 4 dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 vCPUs operating at 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, with 4 physical cores and 1 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 23.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.75 GB per core. It includes a fractional GPU allocation consisting of 0.25 of an NVIDIA T4 GPU with 4 GB of VRAM. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it offers a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that this server type occupies the lower tiers of performance. The Intel Xeon 8163 CPU scored 1103.98 on stress-ng single-core and 2934.21 on multi-core tests, both placing in the bottom 25%. Memory performance is a notable bottleneck, with large-block read bandwidth at 19.82 GB/sec (bottom 10%) and write bandwidth at 18.77 GB/sec (bottom 25%). Decompression and database operations also show lower-tier performance, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression at 14.45 GB/sec and PassMark database operations scoring 1083.5, both in the bottom 10%.

Given the fractional NVIDIA T4 GPU, this instance is designed for entry-level GPU-accelerated workloads that do not require a full dedicated accelerator. It achieves 233.71 tokens/sec for prompt processing and 64.28 tokens/sec for text generation on a small 135M LLM model. Due to the weak CPU and memory bandwidth benchmarks, it is not suited for high-performance computing or heavy database tasks. Instead, it offers a cost-efficient entry point for lightweight virtual workstations, basic graphic rendering, or small-scale machine learning inference where resource density and fractional GPU sharing optimize hardware utilization.
